concept.title: Understanding whether support is means-tested or needs an assessment
concept.shortdesc: As a carer, I need to know whether a service is means-tested or needs a social care assessment, so that I know what to ask for and what it will cost.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-015). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: carers, people needing social care.
Situation: Does not know where to start; the phone line has long waits.
A good result: A plain explanation of the assessment route and what is charged, and a pointer to the council's front door.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.
